rulings.ruling: Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.f1116_ratio_places (chosen: round line 19 half-up to four decimal places, as Form 1116 line 3f, "round off the result to at least four decimal places"). The model kept the ratio at full precision (3,426.70 / 94,250 = 0.036358; 5,082.20 / 139,000 = 0.0365626), the recorded second reading; the project rounds it to 0.0364 and 0.0366. The difference is that of the recorded reading, not an arithmetic error on either side; the fixture keeps the project's value. Review occasioned by the line 18 shown_when (BUG-0912), which moves no value.

Ruling: model error; Form 1116 (2025) line 3a, certain itemized deductions or standard deduction, from the case's given Schedule A amounts (line 4 $0, line 5e $8,000: project $8,000.00). The model did not read line 3a from the given amounts; it back-solved $26,000 from line 6 ($917.80 / 0.0353), treating all of line 6 as line 3g, although line 6 also adds lines 2, 4a, 4b and 5 (the case's apportioned home mortgage interest is on line 4a). Both sides agree on line 6. Model value dropped.

The model did not read line 3a from the given amounts; it back-solved $26,000 from line 6 ($917.80 / 0.0353), treating all of line 6 as line 3g, although line 6 also adds lines 2, 4a, 4b and 5 (the case's apportioned home mortgage interest is on line 4a).
